 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 06-01-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioners apprehending their arrest in connection with Gopalpur (Rangra) P.S. Case no. 346 of 2023 instituted for the offence under Sections 147, 148, 149, 342, 323, 384, 385, 406, 420, 427 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.89155 of 2025(2) dt.06-01-2026 3.

As per allegation in the FIR, accused Prabha Devi had executed an agreement to sale the land in favour of the informant but instead of executing sale deed in favour of informant, she has executed lease agreement in the name of other person.
Informant had given Rs. 5,000/- as consideration money to accused Prabha Rani and rest consideration amount i.e. Rs. 7,95,000/- in the account of her husband, namely, Late Kamla Kant Yadav.

Allegation against these petitioners are that they Ranjan Kumar @ Suraj Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28494928/
1 went to the land in question and destroyed the standing crops.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that they have been falsely implicated in this case.
General and omnibus allegations have been levelled against them.

Specific allegation of receiving money through bank account is against Prabha Rani, who has already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by another co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 4.10.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 9729 of 2024 and the case of these petitioners stands on better footing.
It is mentioned in para 3 of the petition that petitioners have got no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and in Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.89155 of 2025(2) dt.06-01-2026 the facts and circumstances of the case as stated above, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioners on bail.

The petitioners are directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of four weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrender in connection with Gopalpur (Rangra) P.S. Case no. 346 of 2023, they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned ACJM-1, Naugachia subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) sushma/-
